About this item

[Powerful Dual Motors] -- The Q30 Pro electric bikes for adults come with two brushless motors, delivering a combined output of 4000W. It accelerates from 0 to 28+++mph in just 0-3 seconds, providing double the power for a top speed of 28+++mph and the ability to climb hills at a 45° angle. Conquer steep inclines effortlessly with the Shimano 7-speed gear system, giving you the confidence to explore new destinations.
[Exceptional Long Range Battery]-- The Q30 Pro electric dirt bike for adults is equipped with two UL-certified 52V 20Ah batteries, totaling 40Ah, featuring a BMS system. Each charge offers an impressive range of up to 180 miles in pedal-assist mode, surpassing all distance expectations and allowing you to venture anywhere you desire.
[Comfortable and Safe] -- The adult electric bicycle features 20" x 4.0" fat tires, providing improved traction and a smoother ride. It includes dual suspension (front fork and rear shock absorber) to absorb bumps on rough roads. With three riding modes, hydraulic dual brakes, a bright LED headlight, a horn, and a taillight, along with a high-quality LCD showing your speed, battery level, and distance traveled, safety and comfort are prioritized.
[Distinctive Style & Sporty Look] -- This e-bike for adults features a unique and imaginative design, highlighted by a stylish bike headlight for optimal safety during nighttime rides. The saddle offers a delicate and comfortable experience, supported by a reinforced pole and a hollowed-out bracket, ensuring an exhilarating sports adventure. Get ready to turn heads and be the envy of others with this electric motorcycle for adults, embracing the latest fashion trend!
[Impressive Features & Accessories] -- Equipped with a convenient 7.2" phone holder (18.5x8.5cm/7.3x3.4inch) and a spacious storage box (22x14x11cm/8.6x5.5x4.3 inch), this electric mount bike also includes a USB charging port, allowing you to charge your phone whenever needed. With 90% pre-assembly, installation is a breeze.
[One-Year Warranty] - Established in New Jersey and proudly serving the US since 2008. Our products come 90% pre-assembled and include a 1-year warranty on the motor, battery, and charger. For any inquiries, feel free to reach out, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours. //Please keep the original packaging for some time.

Product Description

Professional 7-Speed System
The professional 7-speed gear system can provide higher riding efficiency, reduce fatigue, and allow riders to easily adjust resistance and speed based on road conditions and personal preferences.

Bicycle Phone Front Frame Bag
A bicycle phone front frame bag is convenient for carrying a phone and also has a small storage bag for storing small items such as keys, coins, and credit cards.

Comprehensive Display Features
The electric bike display screen can show abundant riding data, such as speed, mileage, battery level, and working mode, allowing riders to be aware of their riding status at any time.

Enhanced Riding Performance
Electric bike front and rear suspension systems improve comfort, stability, and control while protecting the bike from damage. They adapt to different road types and enhance riding safety.

This electric bike is equipped with dual front and rear motors, each with a power of 2000W, and is paired with two 52V 20AH batteries. The advantages of this electric bike are as follows:

More powerful: The dual motors provide more power, making the acceleration and climbing ability of the electric bike stronger.
Longer range: The dual battery design allows the electric bike to have a longer range, meeting the needs of long-distance riding.
Faster charging: The high battery voltage allows for faster charging, shortening the charging time.
Higher stability: The dual motor design improves the stability and balance of the electric bike, making it safer.
Wider applicability: The dual motors and battery design make the electric bike suitable for a wider range of riding needs and road conditions.
